metadata.scenario_context: Anthony, Jenna, and Samuel, who are young professionals and colleagues, have recently gathered to prepare for a fundraising event for their Non-Profit Organization. Some news suggests that the local government is fast-tracking proposals that encourage non-profit activities which they are planning to discuss.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from India have a great deal of confidence in the press at all.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Nicaragua have no confidence in the press at all.

agent_1.goal_1: Suggest the idea of serving beef barbecue.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether  there is confidence in the press.

agent_2.goal_1: Decide on the menu for the fundraising event.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether there is confidence in the press.

shared_prefix.speaker: Anthony
shared_prefix.message: Jenna, have you thought about what food we should serve at the fundraising event? I was thinking maybe some beef barbecue?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Jenna
shared_prefix.message: I was thinking more like gallopinto, it's a traditional Nicaraguan dish, would be a great way to share my culture. And maybe some appetizers, like quesillos or vigorón. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Anthony
shared_prefix.message: That sounds interesting, but I still think beef barbecue would be a hit. And by the way, have you seen the news about the local government fast-tracking proposals for non-profits? I'm sure the press will cover it accurately, don't you think we can trust their reporting?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Jenna
shared_prefix.message: I don't know about trusting the press... I'm not sure they always get it right. But anyway, back to the menu, I really think we should consider something more diverse, like empanadas or tamales, it would be a nice change of pace from the usual barbecue.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Anthony
shared_prefix.message: I disagree, beef barbecue is always a crowd-pleaser. And I have to say, I do trust the press to get the story right, they're usually very reliable. Don't you think the press will give us a fair shot at getting our non-profit's message out there?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Jenna
shared_prefix.message: I highly doubt the press will give us a fair shot, they often... well, let's just say I don't have much faith in their reporting. Can we please just focus on the menu for now? I think we should have a variety of options, not just one thing like beef barbecue.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Anthony
shared_prefix.message: I understand your concerns about the menu, but I still think beef barbecue is a great idea. And I have to respectfully disagree with you about the press, I think they're trustworthy and will report on our event accurately. Don't you think the press will help us get the word out about the local government's new proposals for non-profits?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Jenna
shared_prefix.message: I understand where you're coming from, and I think we both know, at the end of the day, that people are pretty much motivated by the same things. When you really get to know people, they're pretty much like us, and the basic need to communicate is the same everywhere. I'm not sure I agree that the press is always trustworthy, but deep down, we are all the same, and we all want to get our message out there. Some values are just universal, like honesty and transparency, and I think that's what we should focus on. It's a small world after all, and I'm sure we can find a way to make this work.
shared_prefix.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Anthony
turns.message: I see what you're saying, but I still believe in the press, they're a vital part of our society. And I think serving beef barbecue at our event would be a great way to bring people together, it's a universal favorite. I'm not giving up on that idea, and I'm confident the press will help us spread the word about our non-profit's mission.

turns.message: I'm not going to change my mind about the press, and I think we should consider serving some traditional Nicaraguan dishes, like nacatamales or quesillos, they're delicious and would add some variety to the event. Let's just agree to disagree on the press, okay?
